title: VinesCutter
description:
"The ultimate vine-harvesting utility. Quick, server-sided, and works with all vine types!"
Ver. 1.0.1 when sneaking normal Minecraft behavior and only the one sheared will drop
body:
### Harvest entire chains of vines instantly! 
Shearing one vine block automatically drops all vines below it while consuming durability. Quick, server-sided, and works with all vine types!
Combatible from fabric 1.21.10 - 26.1.2

Ver. 1.0.1 when sneaking, normal Minecraft behavior and only the vine sheared will drop
